_note: All job descriptions below are fictional and written for this project: no real employer, person, address or brand is named, and no text is copied from any posting. They exist only so the generator can reproduce the app's real ingestion + lexical retrieval path. Role families, competency mix and seniority mix follow the Hong Kong market evidence recorded in docs/DATASET.md.

families.market_basis: Largest HK technology specialisation: Java 297, .NET 61, C# 33 postings (May-Jun 2024 sample); middle-level and 1-3 years dominate.

jobs.title: Graduate Backend Software Engineer
jobs.text:
Graduate Backend Software Engineer
Entry level. You will join a small engineering team building internal transaction services with Java and Spring Boot, plus some legacy .NET services.
- Build and maintain REST API endpoints, and keep the database schema consistent with the service contract.
- Write unit tests and integration tests for each endpoint before release.
- Debug production issues on the day they are reported, and join the weekly rotation for release support.
- Work with the team on code review, and keep the decision notes in the ticket.
Requirements: one year or less of hands-on coding, a computing degree or equivalent, and the ability to work in a team. SQL is required.

jobs.title: 見習後端軟件工程師
jobs.text:
見習後端軟件工程師
入門級職位，用 Java 同 Spring Boot 開發內部交易服務。
－ 開發同維護 REST API，確保資料庫結構同介面一致。
－ 每次發佈前寫單元測試。
－ 收到問題當日除錯，同團隊輪流支援發佈。
要求：一年或以下編程經驗，識 SQL。

families.market_basis: Web Development 35 postings, plus front-end work inside other categories; junior full-stack is the common entry route.

jobs.title: Junior Web Developer
jobs.text:
Junior Web Developer
We are a small design studio that builds marketing sites for local shops.
- Build responsive pages with a modern JavaScript framework, and keep the component API simple for other developers.
- Write automated tests for the enquiry and order forms before each release.
- Work with the designer in a two-person team, and communicate changes clearly at the weekly review.
- Explain technical limits to non-technical clients in plain language.
Requirements: a portfolio of at least two pages you built yourself. Fresh graduates and one year of experience are both welcome.

jobs.title: 初級網頁開發員
jobs.text:
初級網頁開發員
幫本地小店做宣傳網站嘅小型設計工作室。
－ 用現代框架做響應式頁面，保持組件 API 簡單。
－ 每次發佈前為表格寫自動測試。
－ 同設計師兩人團隊合作，每週評審時清楚溝通改動。
要求：有兩頁自己整嘅作品，應屆畢業生或一年經驗。

families.market_basis: data analyst 17 + business intelligence analyst 3 postings; SQL 88%, Excel 51%, Tableau 33%, Power BI 25% skill frequency across 349 HK data postings.

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst (Business Intelligence)
jobs.text:
Junior Data Analyst (Business Intelligence)
You will support the commercial side of the business with weekly sales and stock reporting.
- Write SQL to pull figures from the warehouse, and check that row counts reconcile with the source system.
- Maintain the Tableau and Power BI dashboards that business users open every Monday morning.
- Turn a vague request into a clear question, then present the finding to the stakeholder who asked for it.
- Investigate why a number moved before you report it, and say what you checked.
- Treat an unclear reporting request as a problem to clarify, not something to guess.
Requirements: strong Excel, one year of SQL practice, and an eye for detail.

jobs.title: 初級數據分析員（商業智能）
jobs.text:
初級數據分析員（商業智能）
支援業務部門做每週銷售同庫存報表。
－ 用 SQL 從倉庫取數，核對筆數一致。
－ 維護 Tableau 同 Power BI dashboard。
－ 向 stakeholder 匯報結果；要求唔清就當係要解決嘅問題。
要求：Excel 熟練，一年 SQL 經驗。

families.market_basis: data engineer 11 postings; ETL 25%, Spark 30, Hadoop 29, Airflow 12 keyword hits; SQL 88% and Python 52% baseline.

jobs.title: Junior Data Engineer
jobs.text:
Junior Data Engineer
- Build and maintain ETL pipelines that move data from vendor file drops into the analytics warehouse.
- Write Python jobs orchestrated with Airflow, and keep each load idempotent so a rerun does not duplicate rows.
- Model tables in SQL so that analysts can join them without guessing keys.
- Expose a small internal API for the reporting group to request a refresh.
Requirements: Python, SQL, and one year of experience with batch pipelines. Exposure to Spark or Hadoop is a plus.

jobs.title: 初級數據工程師
jobs.text:
初級數據工程師
－ 建立 ETL pipeline，把數據由供應商檔案搬入分析倉庫。
－ 用 Python 寫 job，由 Airflow 排程，重跑唔會重複。
－ 用 SQL 設計表；提供細型內部 API 讓報表組要求重新整理。
要求：Python、SQL，一年批次 pipeline 經驗。

families.market_basis: AI 37 postings and machine learning in 33% of HK data postings; Python 52% baseline; mostly middle level.

jobs.title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.text:
Junior Machine Learning Engineer
- Train and evaluate models on tabular and text data with Python and a standard machine learning library.
- Own the offline evaluation: split the data honestly, report precision and recall, and state what the baseline was.
- Package a model behind a small HTTP API so the product group can call it.
- Read the data carefully before modelling, and document what you excluded and why.
Requirements: one year of practical machine learning work, Python, and basic statistics.

jobs.title: 初級機器學習工程師
jobs.text:
初級機器學習工程師
－ 用 Python 同機器學習套件為表格式同文字數據訓練模型。
－ 負責離線評估：誠實分割數據，報告 precision 同 recall。
－ 把模型包成 HTTP API 讓產品組呼叫。
要求：一年機器學習實務、Python、基本統計。

families.market_basis: Testing/QA/UAT work is spread across many HK junior postings (business analyst / data analyst / UAT / QA titles); QA is often the entry point into delivery teams.

jobs.title: Junior QA / UAT Engineer
jobs.text:
Junior QA / UAT Engineer
- Write test cases from the requirement document, then run them before each release.
- Reproduce a defect with clear steps, logs and screenshots so a developer can fix it quickly.
- Run UAT sessions with business users, and confirm the sign-off in writing.
- Work with the development team to agree which defects block the release.
- Chase a problem until you can reproduce it consistently.
Requirements: meticulous and patient, comfortable communicating with both users and developers. One year of testing experience or a fresh graduate.

jobs.title: 初級 QA／UAT 工程師
jobs.text:
初級 QA／UAT 工程師
－ 按需求文件寫測試個案，發佈前逐項執行。
－ 用清楚步驟同截圖重現 defect。
－ 同業務用戶做 UAT，用書面確認 sign-off。
－ 同開發團隊一齊定邊個 defect 要阻住發佈；重現唔到就慢慢除錯。
要求：細心，識同用戶同開發溝通。

families.market_basis: IT Support 240 postings, the largest single non-language specialisation in the May-Jun 2024 HK sample; junior-weighted.

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer (Internal Systems)
jobs.text:
IT Support Engineer (Internal Systems)
- Handle tickets from office users: password resets, shared drive access, laptops that will not start.
- Troubleshoot and solve first-line issues yourself, and escalate with logs when the cause is deeper.
- Run a simple SQL query to check an account or order state before you reply.
- Explain the fix in plain language, and write the steps into the knowledge base.
- Rotate with the team for floor support during office hours.
Requirements: one year of helpdesk experience or a fresh graduate, patient, and able to communicate clearly in writing.

jobs.title: IT 支援工程師（內部系統）
jobs.text:
IT 支援工程師（內部系統）
－ 處理同事嘅 ticket：密碼、共享磁碟、開唔到機嘅電腦。
－ 先自己排查同解決一線問題，查唔到就帶 log 升級。
－ 回覆前用簡單 SQL 查帳戶狀態，再寫入知識庫。
－ 同團隊輪流做樓層支援。
要求：一年 helpdesk 經驗或應屆畢業生，書面溝通清楚。

families.market_basis: Business Analysis 45 + system analyst 2 postings; requirement writing and stakeholder work dominate the junior-middle band.

jobs.title: Junior Business Systems Analyst
jobs.text:
Junior Business Systems Analyst
- Run interviews with business users, then write user stories that a developer can build from.
- Map the current process, measure where time is lost using simple data from the team's own reports, and suggest one change.
- Present the options and your recommendation to stakeholders in a short written note.
- Work with the delivery team to confirm scope before development starts.
- Enjoy untangling a problem that arrives as a vague complaint.
Requirements: strong written English and Cantonese, one year of analyst experience or a fresh graduate.

jobs.title: 初級業務系統分析員
jobs.text:
初級業務系統分析員
－ 同業務用戶做訪談，寫成開發同事可以照做嘅 user story。
－ 用團隊報表嘅數據量度邊一步最嘥時間。
－ 向 stakeholder 匯報方案同建議。
－ 同事只講「有問題」嘅時候，逐步問清楚再解決。
要求：中英文書寫流利。

families.market_basis: Cloud 43 postings; Azure in 20% and AWS in 17% of HK data postings; Docker 14, Kubernetes and pipeline work usually at middle level.

jobs.title: Junior Cloud / DevOps Engineer
jobs.text:
Junior Cloud / DevOps Engineer
- Package a small internal API service with Docker, then deploy it through the company Azure pipeline.
- Keep each deployment reproducible: one command, one log, and a test stage that runs before production.
- Watch the dashboards for errors, and debug a failed deployment from the pipeline log.
- Look after the managed database: backups, restore drills, and a simple access rule.
Requirements: one year with Linux or cloud tooling, or a fresh graduate with a home lab. Azure or AWS exposure is a plus.

jobs.title: 初級雲端／DevOps 工程師
jobs.text:
初級雲端／DevOps 工程師
－ 用 Docker 打包內部 API 服務，經 Azure pipeline 部署。
－ 部署要可重複：正式環境前先跑測試階段。
－ 睇 dashboard 有冇錯誤，部署失敗就由 pipeline log 除錯。
－ 照顧代管資料庫：備份同還原演練。
要求：一年 Linux 或雲端經驗。

families.market_basis: Mobile work appears through Web Development 35, ERP 30 and app-support postings; small HK teams hire one junior mobile developer to sit with backend and operations.

jobs.title: Junior Mobile App Developer
jobs.text:
Junior Mobile App Developer
- Build screens for an Android app that field staff use to log site visits, and call the existing JSON API.
- Write unit tests for the form validation, and check the app on two screen sizes before you hand it over.
- Communicate release notes to the operations lead, and confirm the roll-out date in writing.
- Fix reported problems quickly, and ask for a screenshot when the description is unclear.
Requirements: one year of Kotlin or Swift, or a fresh graduate with a published side project.

jobs.title: 初級手機應用程式開發員
jobs.text:
初級手機應用程式開發員
－ 為 Android app 開發介面，接駁現有 JSON API。
－ 為表格驗證寫單元測試，交貨前在兩個屏幕尺寸檢查。
－ 向營運主管溝通發佈內容，書面確認推出日期。
－ 收到問題就盡快解決。
要求：一年 Kotlin 或 Swift 經驗。

families.market_basis: HK security demand: Security 40, Information Security 37, Cyber Security 36, Cybersecurity 30, Network Security 15, IT Security 8 postings (~166); certification demand CISA/CISM 167, CISSP 119, CEH 36, OSCP 18, ISO 27001 11.

jobs.title: Junior Security Analyst (SOC)
jobs.text:
Junior Security Analyst (SOC)
You will join a two-person security team covering office hours, with an on-call rotation for alerts.
- Triage SIEM alerts from Splunk, and decide within the shift whether each alert is a false positive or an incident.
- Investigate phishing reports, pull the mail headers, and write the incident timeline in the ticket before you hand over.
- Run the monthly vulnerability scan with Nessus and follow up the findings with the system owners.
- Test the firewall rule change on a lab copy before anyone touches production.
- Debug an unusual login pattern with the network colleague, and keep a SQL table of who holds which account.
- Communicate the risk in plain language to a manager who is not technical, and keep the evidence for the ISO 27001 audit in one folder.
Requirements: one year in a SOC, or a fresh graduate with a security module. CISA, CISSP or CEH study is supported but not required.

jobs.title: 初級資訊安全分析師（SOC）
jobs.text:
初級資訊安全分析師（SOC）
－ 處理 Splunk 嘅 SIEM alert，判斷係 false positive 定 incident。
－ 調查釣魚電郵，寫清楚 incident timeline。
－ 改 firewall rule 之前，先喺 lab 副本做測試。
－ 用 SQL 記錄邊個持有邊個帳戶；同網絡同事除錯異常登入。
－ 用簡單講法向非技術主管溝通風險。
要求：一年 SOC 經驗，或修過安全相關科目。

families.market_basis: HK infrastructure demand: Network 77, Networks & Systems Administration 404, IT Infrastructure 29; tools Firewalls 199, Cisco 129, VMware 184, Linux 233, Windows 308; certs CCNA/CCNP 322, ITIL 120.

jobs.title: Junior Network and Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.text:
Junior Network and Infrastructure Engineer
- Configure switch VLANs and firewall rules from an approved change request, and arrange the patch window with the office manager.
- Troubleshoot a VPN tunnel that keeps dropping for staff working from home, and solve it before the next morning.
- Look after the Windows and Linux servers on VMware, and keep the backup database ready for a failover drill.
- Communicate each change to the users affected, and confirm the result with them afterwards.
- Work in a small team with the vendor when a fault needs escalation.
Requirements: CCNA level knowledge, one year of hands-on networking, or a fresh graduate with a home lab.

jobs.title: 初級網絡及基建工程師
jobs.text:
初級網絡及基建工程師
－ 按批核嘅 change request 設定 VLAN 同 firewall rule，約好 patch window。
－ 排查同事在家工作斷線嘅 VPN tunnel，並盡快解決。
－ 用 VMware 管理 Windows 同 Linux server，令備份資料庫可做 failover。
－ 同團隊一齊跟 vendor；每次改動都同受影響同事溝通。
要求：有 CCNA 程度知識。

families.market_basis: HK demand: Project Management 105 + IT Project Management 18, Programme & Project Management 281; tools Jira 126; certs PMP 177, PRINCE2 55, ITIL 120.

jobs.title: Junior IT Project Coordinator
jobs.text:
Junior IT Project Coordinator
- Keep the Jira sprint board and the RAID log current, and follow up each action with its owner before stand-up.
- Book the UAT window with the business team, and chase sign-off before the go-live checklist is signed.
- Track project data such as defect counts and milestone dates, and put one page in front of stakeholders every Friday.
- Turn a blocked dependency into a clear problem statement with two options, then ask for a decision.
- Work with the vendor on the statement of work, and keep the change log aligned with what was agreed.
- Expect some OT during the release week; we plan the roster together.
Requirements: organised, comfortable writing in English and Chinese, one year of coordination work or a fresh graduate.

jobs.title: 初級 IT 項目統籌
jobs.text:
初級 IT 項目統籌
－ 保持 Jira sprint board 同 RAID log 最新。
－ 同業務團隊約 UAT 時間窗，go-live 前追齊 sign-off。
－ 追蹤項目數據，例如 defect 數目同里程碑日期，每星期向 stakeholder 交一頁更新。
－ 被卡住嘅依賴整理成清楚嘅問題，附兩個方案再請人決定，唔好等問題自己解決。
要求：有條理，中英文書寫順暢。

families.market_basis: HK junior digital/performance marketing work: SEO, SEM/Google Ads, Meta ads, GA4 and Looker Studio reporting, EDM, KOL coordination, bilingual copy; small in-house teams pair it with sales targets.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Executive (Junior)
jobs.text:
Digital Marketing Executive (Junior)
- Run Google Ads and Meta campaigns for two retail brands, and keep the daily budget inside the approved plan.
- Read GA4 and Looker Studio data every week, and report CTR, CPA and ROAS in one page for the brand manager.
- Write bilingual copy for EDM and social posts, and coordinate the content calendar with the KOL agency.
- Work with the design team on assets, and communicate the brief before the deadline, not after.
- When a campaign underperforms, find the problem before you ask for more budget.
Requirements: one year of digital marketing or a fresh graduate with a portfolio. Comfortable with numbers, and with Cantonese and English copy.

jobs.title: 初級數碼營銷主任
jobs.text:
初級數碼營銷主任
－ 為兩個零售品牌執行 Google Ads 同 Meta campaign。
－ 每星期睇 GA4 同 Looker Studio 數據，交一頁 CTR、CPA 同 ROAS。
－ 寫中英雙語 EDM 同帖文文案，同 KOL agency 協調內容日曆。
－ 同設計團隊溝通 brief；campaign 表現差就先搵問題再解決。
要求：一年數碼營銷經驗或應屆畢業生。

families.market_basis: HK demand: Consultants 146 + Sales - Pre & Post 73 postings; junior entry is usually through support or implementation, then demo and proposal work.

jobs.title: Junior Pre-Sales Consultant
jobs.text:
Junior Pre-Sales Consultant
- Prepare and run product demos for client teams, and answer questions on how the software fits their existing process.
- Write the technical section of an RFP response: scope, assumptions, integration points and a short API overview.
- Run a client workshop to agree scope and pricing with our sales colleague, then hand the project over to delivery.
- Work in a small team with the implementation engineer, and confirm what was promised in writing the same day.
- Turn an unclear requirement into a concrete problem statement before you quote for it.
Requirements: confident presenting to a small audience, one year in consulting or product support, or a fresh graduate. Cantonese and English are both needed.

jobs.title: 初級售前顧問
jobs.text:
初級售前顧問
－ 為客戶準備同主持 product demo，解釋軟件如何配合流程。
－ 撰寫 RFP 技術部分：範圍、假設同簡短 API 概覽。
－ 同銷售同事搞客戶工作坊，議定範圍同價格。
－ 同實施工程師組成細團隊，當日書面確認承諾；要求唔清就先解決清楚再報價。
要求：可以向小團隊做簡報並匯報結果，需要廣東話同英文。
